purpose: 解释器、包来源、pip / pytest 版本、激活文件、工作区初态
cmd: id; echo VIRTUAL_ENV=$VIRTUAL_ENV; echo RH2_BASHENV_WRITE=$( ( : >> /rh2/bash_env ) 2>/dev/null && echo WRITABLE || echo DENIED ); python -c 'import sys; print("RH2_SYS_EXECUTABLE="+sys.executable)'; python -c 'import scrapy, twisted; print("scrapy", scrapy.__version__, scrapy.__file__, "twisted", twisted.__version__)'; python -m pip --version 2>&1 | head -1; python -m pytest --version 2>&1 | head -1; git status --porcelain=v1; echo PORCELAIN_RC=$?

purpose: 公开读者建议命令（public_read.md 第 1 个命令块）
cmd: python -m scrapy.cmdline shell -c "fetch('file:///testbed/tests/sample_data/test_site/index.html') or __import__('time').sleep(1)" --set TWISTED_REACTOR=twisted.internet.asyncioreactor.AsyncioSelectorReactor >/tmp/r2e_c1.out 2>/tmp/r2e_c1.err; echo "exit=$?"; cat /tmp/r2e_c1.out; grep -E "Using reactor|Using asyncio event loop|Crawled \(|Spider error processing|RuntimeError" /tmp/r2e_c1.err
